277808198.description:
Glass Insulator Lot - 3 Pieces
Hemingray, Ohio Valley Glass Co. (O.V.G. Co.)
Aqua and Teal Green, Vintage
Collection of three vintage glass insulators originally utilized for telegraph and telephone line insulation. This lot features insulators from prominent American manufacturers, showcasing the industrial aqua and teal green glass common to early 20th-century utility production. These heavy pressed glass pieces are sought after for their historical industrial aesthetic and display appeal.
Pieces Included:
Insulator, Aqua, marked "O.V.G. CO." - features a large chip on the side and base
Insulator, Teal Green, marked "N 21" - internal vertical crack visible on the crown
Insulator, Aqua/Teal, marked "HEMINGRAY" - exhibits surface scratching and minor flea bites
Condition:
The lot is in damaged vintage condition as noted and photographed. One insulator has a significant chip loss on the lower body. A second piece shows a distinct crack through the glass dome. The Hemingray piece retains its shape but shows signs of outdoor weathering and light surface wear. Recommended for rustic decor or craft projects.

277779322.description:
Cross Century Pen and Pencil Set
Vintage Writing Instruments
14K Gold Filled, With Original Presentation Box
A classic Cross Century writing set featuring a ballpoint pen and matching mechanical pencil, both crafted with a 14K gold filled finish. The Century line is a cornerstone of American fine writing, renowned for its sleek, slim profile and iconic conical top. These instruments represent the height of 20th-century American manufacturing and remain highly sought after by professionals and collectors for their timeless design and reliable performance.
14K gold filled construction featuring a polished pinstripe engine-turned texture
Set includes one ballpoint pen and one matching mechanical pencil
Original brown presentation box with a satin-lined interior and lifetime guarantee text
Each instrument is engraved "CROSS 14K GOLD FILLED MADE IN USA" near the cap
Condition:
The gold-filled finish shows minor surface scuffs and light micro-scratching consistent with age and gentle use. No significant dents, deep scratches, or brassing observed. The mechanical mechanisms are intact; however, the pen may require a fresh ink refill for optimal performance. The presentation box is in good structural condition with light shelf wear to the exterior fabric and minor fraying on the interior elastic holders.
